t2.thesis: ACHR is a high-vol, heavily shorted, beaten-down eVTOL name with a ~14% implied move, so the post-earnings open is close to a coin flip with a slight lean from cluster base rates offset by weak momentum and mixed recent print reactions.
reasons: Cluster and overall base rates sit at 0.54-0.59, but the AMC session rate is a bit lower at 0.538
Stock is down 55% over 12 months and 52% below its 52w high; sector sentiment is weak despite Joby's strong print lifting peers
Last 4 prints: win rate 0.5 with large EPS beats yet raw returns of -2.8%, +0.3%, +7.2%, -17.6%, so beats do not translate into gains
Implied move of ~14% is large and symmetric, with ATM IV about 2x realized vol, which gives no directional edge
High short interest (17%) and cheap-to-beat estimates are a modest positive, while pending Boeing deal dilution and Joby litigation are modest negatives
t2.deciding_variable: Whether Archer shows credible progress on eIPP launch timing, UAE operations and Boeing deal closing, with cash burn staying within guidance, versus a widening loss or a dilutive capital raise.

prior.from: D004 base rates: drones_robotics_space_defense cluster 0.586 (n=278), AMC 0.538, overall validation 0.542; blended to ~0.55

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-06, so the 2026-11-09 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how ACHR's stock reacted to it.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 0.05 from 0.55 to 0.50: weak 12m momentum, an unreliable beat-to-reaction link, and put skew offset the positive cluster base rate and short-squeeze potential.

theses.expected: Relief rally on in-line burn and firm Midnight and eIPP timelines, with squeeze from short interest
theses.mechanism: Depressed stock, 17% short float, and a Joby read-through lift the open
theses.wrong_if: Burn widens materially or eIPP and UAE operations slip into 2027

theses.expected: Selloff on wider losses, higher burn, or an equity raise announcement
theses.mechanism: Cash-burning pre-revenue company with dilution risk and a sector under pressure from rising yields
theses.wrong_if: Management reiterates the liquidity runway of about $1.6B and no raise appears

theses.expected: Muted or mixed reaction with a gap close to flat
theses.mechanism: Little new information since the Q2 deal update; the EPS beat is already largely priced in
theses.wrong_if: A new defense contract or certification milestone is announced with the print
